    "body": "Distribution update — 15 September 2026\r\n\r\nThe large PRIMITIVE_357_FIRST_SUBMISSION_COMPANION_V1.zip asset has been withdrawn because it included a copy of the Dahmen–Siksek working paper without redistribution permission. A replacement that omits that paper is being prepared. The original filename and SHA-256 value remain in the historical audit records; they do not identify an available download.\r\n\r\nThe author’s own earlier PDF and two-file source ZIP remain here as historical manuscript versions. The current revised manuscript and source upload are linked from the [repository README](https://github.com/bbpcho/primitive-357-proof-audit). No arXiv submission has been made.\r\n\r\nThis withdrawal changes distribution, not the mathematical statements or the scope of the previously recorded computations. The earlier replay records retain their original input identities; no new complete arithmetic replay is claimed. Other third-party redistribution matters remain under review.\r\n\r\nSHA256SUMS.txt is retained as the original asset ledger, including the withdrawn companion. GitHub’s automatically generated source archives contain the smaller control repository."

parsed_json.name: Audit snapshot — rank gate open
parsed_json.body:
# Audit snapshot — rank gate open

This snapshot establishes a clean Git-based review boundary for the proposed
proof of the primitive generalized Fermat equation `x^3 + y^5 = z^7`.

## Included in Git

- the current V3 manuscript source and reference PDF;
- the V3 dependency indexes, strict manifests, compact sector logs, and
  release verifiers;
- the independent V2 review and Section 7 Kummer repair materials;
- readable control files for the post-V3 p=5 obstruction closure;
- readable control files for the post-V3 B124/D4 reconstruction;
- a machine-readable proof-status ledger and exact rank-gap completion
  contract.

## Release assets

The six large immutable archives are listed in `evidence/assets.json` and
`evidence/checksums/RELEASE_ASSETS_SHA256.txt`.  Verify downloaded copies with:

```bash
python3 -B scripts/verify_assets.py --assets-dir /path/to/downloads
```

The p=5 obstruction dependency closure is attached to this prerelease.  The
remaining listed archives are checksum-pinned but not yet attached.

## Current result

Repository integrity, archive identity, and paper compilation pass.  The V3
clean-extraction replay is preserved.  The p=5 and B124/D4 provenance gaps now
have closed replay packages.

The saturation and split-23 logarithm calculations are complete at the current
evidence boundary.  The mathematical Mordell--Weil rank upper-bound and
composition audit remains open.  Therefore this is deliberately a prerelease
audit snapshot, not a claim that the final proof has been independently
completed.

See `docs/RANK_GAP.md` for the exact completion gates.
